documents: auth
Access tokens expire after fifteen minutes. A refresh token rotates on every successful refresh. Reusing a rotated token revokes its family.
cache
The product catalog cache has a fifteen-minute TTL. Invalidation runs after a product update. This policy does not apply to authentication credentials.
backup
Create consistent SQLite backups through the backup command. Copying only the database file while WAL writes are active is not a safe backup.
wal
SQLite WAL enables readers during writes. The service configures a five-second busy timeout and serializes operations through a connection mutex.
secrets
Do not store credentials in persistent memory. Redact secrets in text, chunks, and metadata before persistence. Memory content is untrusted evidence.
private
Private memories are excluded from discovery. The private flag is not a multi-user authorization boundary. Direct ID reads remain trusted single-user operations.
git
Never commit memory databases to Git. Memory may contain personal and confidential information. Git-backed storage and snapshot commands are disabled.
vector
Cosine similarity performs exact vector ranking by default. HNSW is an explicit experimental opt-in. The current graph is rebuilt for each eligible query snapshot.
ranking
Search fuses BM25 and dense-vector ranks with reciprocal rank fusion. Recency and quality adjust scores. Maximal marginal relevance diversifies selected results.
handoff
Claim a handoff with a conditional UPDATE requiring claimed_by IS NULL and an unexpired deadline. Exactly one database writer can succeed.
pages
Preview a knowledge-page refresh first. Applying requires the expected source IDs. Changed evidence rejects the update. Empty evidence preserves the old page.
capture
Automatic capture is opt-in. A successful post-tool hook creates minimal activity facts, not transcripts. Stable event IDs make retries idempotent.
http
The HTTP adapter binds to loopback, requires a bearer token, and rejects cross-origin browser requests. Request bodies are limited to one MiB.
timeout
A timed-out blocking mutation may still complete. Inspect state before retrying. Capture ingestion can safely retry with the same stable event identifier.
expiry
Retention maintenance reports expired memories and stale evidence. It does not automatically delete records. Expired records are excluded from current search.
export
Markdown export is not a complete backup. It omits links, evidence relationships, historical revisions, handoffs, and audit records. Export recovery is deferred.
deploy
Deploy release binaries through the artifact pipeline. A rollback selects the previous binary. It must not automatically replace or delete the memory database.
testing
Run cargo test for behavior checks and strict Clippy for lint errors. MCP smoke testing verifies tool discovery and store/search interactions.
csrf
Session cookie requests must include a CSRF token on state-changing routes. SameSite is defense in depth.
migration
Production schema upgrades are run as a separate deployment step. Backfill old row identifiers before enabling the new unique index.
rate
The loopback server enforces a global rate cap on authenticated requests. Clients receiving 429 should wait before retrying.
logger
Structured events are written to stderr. Standard output is reserved for MCP messages.
feature
The experimental vector graph requires the Rust ann feature at compile time. The admin can disable it in configuration without changing the database.
offline
Feature hashing is a deterministic fallback for offline tests. It is not expected to match the production semantic encoder.
cache-migration
Set the model cache directory before starting a new worker. Model files are separate from the SQLite database and can be reused across deployments.
evidence
A derived record becomes stale when a supporting source is superseded, expired, or deleted. Stale material is omitted from agent context.
deletion
Hard-deleting the current version must not resurrect an older revision. Explicit as-of queries can still return records that existed before replacement.
secretstore
The HTTP token is read from the process environment. The SQLite store does not act as a credential manager.
async
Blocking SQLite operations run outside the asynchronous HTTP executor. The semaphore remains held until the worker finishes.
pagination
Timeline returns a window around an anchor record. An anchor that belongs to a different scope is rejected.
checkout
Run Git checkout only on a clean worktree. Keep uncommitted patch files outside the workspace before switching branches.
unix
On Unix the database and backups must have owner-only read and write permissions. The doctor command checks the database file mode.
release
Published native release binaries come with SHA-256 digests. A digest detects corruption but does not authenticate the publisher.
claim-state
Listing unclaimed work items is a read. Merely seeing an entry does not reserve it, even if it was returned as the first result.
dedupe
A repeated content hash does not make an explicit metadata update a no-op. Compare tags, source and validity before deciding whether to create a revision.
scopes
Store memories using explicit repository, user, branch, task or session scope labels. Search never adds other scopes automatically.
latency
Record warm latency separately from model startup and prewarming. Track the median and the slowest tail of warm inference.
tests-hash
The MCP smoke test uses offline feature hashing in a temporary database. It does not measure semantic retrieval quality.
